newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Obayashi to on-sell Transurban shares.
newsitem.headline: Obayashi to on-sell Transurban shares.

text.p: Japanese construction group Obayashi Corp has entered into a financing and forward sale agreement for A$50 million of stapled securities in Melbourne motorway builder Transurban City Link Ltd.

"Under the forward sale agreement, Trust Company of Australia as trustee of the Infrastructure Trust of Australia has agreed to purchase Obayashi's equity in Transurban when Obayashi is free to dispose of it, expected to be in December 2001," Transurban said.

Obayashi, as one of the participants in the Transurban motorway joint venture, was obliged to subscribe for the A$50 million in securities on completion of the motorway as part of the joint venture agreement.
"Obayashi has also confirmed that the forward sale agreement has no effect on its commitment to the City Link project or its obligations to Transurban under the project documents," Transurban said.
